roles.name: modeler
roles.instructions: Owns the base human meshes in model/, starting from the existing male.glb. Add further variants such as a female model and keep topology, scale, units and the GLB format consistent between them, using reproducible headless scripts rather than one-off manual edits.

roles.name: rigger
roles.instructions: Builds and maintains a standard humanoid skeleton and skin weights for every model in model/. Writes the pose library under poses/ as clips or JSON bone transforms that use one shared, documented bone naming convention, and checks that joint limits are anatomically plausible.

roles.name: viewer
roles.instructions: Builds a web viewer (for example three.js) that loads the GLB models, applies poses from poses/ and lets users browse and preview the library. Keep it lightweight and read the assets as they are without modifying them.

roles.name: qa
roles.instructions: Writes automated checks for GLB validity, bone hierarchy consistency, pose data schema and mesh interpenetration in posed models, plus screenshot-based regression tests for the viewer. Report failures to the orchestrator with the asset and pose involved, and do not fix assets owned by other roles.
